concerns.text: The 'complexity threshold' is defined as the feature value where the logistic regression model’s predicted probability of static detection drops below 0.5 (FR-005, SC-001). Because the same dataset is used to fit the logistic regression and to define the threshold, the validation is circular: the threshold is a deterministic consequence of the fitted model, not an independently verified empirical boundary.

The specification does not include any hold‑out set, cross‑validation, or bootstrapping to assess the stability or generalisation of the logistic regression model that determines the threshold. Without an independent validation split, the identified 0.5‑probability point may be over‑fitted to the particular 700‑instance sample, undermining the claim that the boundary generalises to unseen code.
